item.title: Court gives Kim Davis four days to explain why she hid her assets to avoid paying a gay couple $565K - LGBTQ Nation
item.description:
submitted by remote to politics
431 points | 1 comment
https://www.lgbtqnation.com/2026/11/court-gives-kim-davis-four-days-to-explain-why-she-hid-her-assets-to-avoid-paying-a-gay-couple-565k/

A federal judge said in a November 6 legal filing that former Kentucky county clerk Kim Davis issued false responses about her assets in an inquiry to decide how she can repay her court-ordered payment of $565,000 to David Ermold and David Moore. Davis discriminated against the same-sex couple in 2015 when she illegally denied a marriage license to them, shortly after the US Supreme Court’s landmark Obergefell v. Hodges ruling legalized same-sex marriage nationwide.

Moore and Ermold said that the list of personal assets Davis shared with the court after it ordered her to pay the aforementioned sum was “materially false.” Davis said she owned no real estate, made no large transfers, and was not a beneficiary of any estate, WKYT reported. However, the couple said they discovered certified records in Rowan County showing that she had inherited 50% of her mother’s estate as well as signed deeds in 2025 transferring that property to her family members.

item.title: 2026 General Elections Megathread!
item.description:
submitted by jordanlund to politics
140 points | 221 comments

There’s a separate thread for the Senate elections, because that’s far, far easier to track than the House races and the Gubernatorial races.

Consider this thread open to everything else! House, Governor, state and local measures, everything else!

Polls start closing at 7 PM Eastern, 4 PM Pacific. My plan is to be obsessively posting results as they come in.
